subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should xAI video polling and provider-supplied download URLs fail closed for private-network targets by default, with access allowed only through the existing explicit request-policy opt-in?
rationale: The patch is technically consistent with guarded sibling providers, but it deliberately changes previously permissive poll/download behavior at an upgrade-sensitive security boundary.

options.title: Confirm Fail-Closed Boundary
options.body: Approve the guarded default, retain explicit private-network opt-in, update the branch, and require green exact-head checks before merge.

options.title: Preserve Permissive Compatibility
options.body: Rework the change to preserve unguarded legacy behavior by default, accepting continued SSRF exposure for existing workflows.

options.title: Pause This Provider Fix
options.body: Defer the xAI change until the broader multi-provider repair in the canonical issue establishes one shared migration policy.

recommendation.title: Confirm Fail-Closed Boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the guarded default, retain explicit private-network opt-in, update the branch, and require green exact-head checks before merge.
